newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaican bauxite, alumina production up.
newsitem.headline: Jamaican bauxite, alumina production up.

text.p: KINGSTON, Jamaica, May 27, Reuter - The Jamaica Bauxite Institute said on Tuesday Jamaica's alumina and bauxite production both increased for the first quarter of this year, with local plants running at near-full capacity.

According to the state-run JBI, bauxite production rose 1.7 per cent between January and March, from 2.93 million tonnes to 2.98 million tonnes. Alumina production increased 2.4 pct, from 794,844 tonnes to 816,999 tonnes.

The island's three alumina plants operated at a combined production capacity of 96 percent over the quarter, and the JBI predicts that, if the trend continues, total alumina production for this year will reach 3.3 million tonnes.
JBI also notes that wage settlements have been concluded at all three plants "without any industrial interruptions".
Gross foreign exchange earnings for the sector in January and February fell US$19 million, due to a 25.7 percent decline in exports.
The JBI said this was due "to a lag in shipping schedules" and subsequent export figures are not expected to follow this trend.
